considered_and_dismissed.candidate: A target agent could put receipt-shaped JSON inside its reply so the caller waits on a fake execution_id
considered_and_dismissed.why_dismissed: A receipt is the tool's own answer, not text inside a reply; a target can already lie in its reply, and get_execution_result is gated to self ∪ permitted. No boundary is crossed that was not crossable before.

considered_and_dismissed.candidate: The contract's 'not found → re-send it word for word' step could duplicate work if idempotency begin() fails open
considered_and_dismissed.why_dismissed: Needs two simultaneous failures (the ledger check missing a live row AND the idempotency store failing open); the worst case is one extra execution of the same work, not amplification. Documented in requirements §37.2 as the reason the MCP server itself does not probe this way; accepted as residual for an agent-level instruction.

considered_and_dismissed.candidate: 'the outcome will be sent to you' is false for a system-scoped requester of a gated skill
considered_and_dismissed.why_dismissed: Pre-existing in ent#751's shipped MCP message, not introduced here; honesty defect, not a security boundary. Filed as abilityai/trinity#3233.
